rdfs:comment: Hand-written A-Commerce terms: better comments, super-types, and terms not in the database yet. `cargo xtask check-schema --write` merges these with the terms used in migration comments and the word lists in crates/core/src/enums.rs into vocab/acom.jsonld. Rules: docs/api/vocabulary.md.

@graph.rdfs:label: wireList
@graph.rdfs:comment: Name of the word list this enumeration is stored as in the API and database (docs/api/enums.md).

@graph.rdfs:label: wireWord
@graph.rdfs:comment: The snake_case word this member is written as in the API and database.

@graph.rdfs:label: Promotion
@graph.rdfs:comment: A set of sale prices for some products, for some shoppers, for a period. Used as additionalType on an OfferCatalog.

@graph.rdfs:label: Coupon
@graph.rdfs:comment: A discount a shopper can apply to an order, identified by schema:discountCode. Used as additionalType on an Offer. It records a benefit on the order; it does not add a second discount on top of a member price.

@graph.rdfs:label: MemberCoupon
@graph.rdfs:comment: A coupon issued to one member, with its own status and validity. Used as additionalType on OwnershipInfo.

@graph.rdfs:label: Cart
@graph.rdfs:comment: An order the shopper has not placed yet. Used as additionalType on an Order.

@graph.rdfs:label: CartLine
@graph.rdfs:comment: One line of a cart. Used as additionalType on an OrderItem.

@graph.rdfs:label: Claim
@graph.rdfs:comment: A shopper's request to cancel, return, or exchange order items. Used as additionalType on CancelAction (cancel) or ReturnAction (return, exchange).

@graph.rdfs:label: Refund
@graph.rdfs:comment: Money paid back to a shopper for a claim. Used as additionalType on a MoneyTransfer.

@graph.rdfs:label: Banner
@graph.rdfs:comment: Content shown in a display slot: headline, image, link. Used as additionalType on a CreativeWork.

@graph.rdfs:label: DisplayBooking
@graph.rdfs:comment: A banner placed in a display slot for an audience and a period. Used as additionalType on a Schedule.

@graph.rdfs:label: Preference
@graph.rdfs:comment: Something the store remembers about a shopper, visible to the shopper and undoable. Used as additionalType on a PropertyValue.

@graph.rdfs:label: ChangeSet
@graph.rdfs:comment: A versioned list of previewed actions that a person approves, runs, and can undo together. Used as additionalType on an ItemList.

@graph.rdfs:label: Task
@graph.rdfs:comment: Work proposed to an operator (by a person, an agent, or an automation), opened as a conversation. Used as additionalType on an Action.

@graph.rdfs:label: Segment
@graph.rdfs:comment: A group of customers defined by conditions. Used as additionalType on an Audience.

@graph.rdfs:label: EventReward
@graph.rdfs:comment: A prize for one rank of an event. Used as additionalType on an Offer.

@graph.rdfs:label: DrawRecord
@graph.rdfs:comment: A reproducible record of a prize draw: method, seed commitment, entrants, result. Used as additionalType on a ChooseAction.

@graph.rdfs:label: TierRequirement
@graph.rdfs:comment: What a member must reach to hold a tier (spend, order count, points) over a window.

@graph.rdfs:label: ComplianceRule
@graph.rdfs:comment: A store-defined rule for prize reporting, withholding, or winner information in a jurisdiction.

@graph.rdfs:label: safetyStock
@graph.rdfs:comment: Units kept back from sale; inventory_level minus this is what shoppers can buy.

@graph.rdfs:label: percentOff
@graph.rdfs:comment: The requested discount behind a computed sale price, 0-100.

@graph.rdfs:label: inventoryCost
@graph.rdfs:comment: What one unit costs the store. Visible to operators only; used for price floors.

@graph.rdfs:label: rank
@graph.rdfs:comment: Order of a tier within its program; higher is better.

@graph.rdfs:label: confirmedAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: When the purchase was confirmed after delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: approvalStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a product is in review before shoppers can see it.

@graph.rdfs:label: fulfillmentStage
@graph.rdfs:comment: The warehouse step of an order item or delivery.

@graph.rdfs:label: deliveryState
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a parcel is.

@graph.rdfs:label: claimType
@graph.rdfs:comment: Cancel, return, or exchange.

@graph.rdfs:label: claimStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a claim is.

@graph.rdfs:label: claimReason
@graph.rdfs:comment: Why the shopper returns or exchanges.

@graph.rdfs:label: cancelReason
@graph.rdfs:comment: Why an order is cancelled.

@graph.rdfs:label: liability
@graph.rdfs:comment: Who is responsible, which decides who pays.

@graph.rdfs:label: inspectionCondition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Condition of a returned item after inspection.

@graph.rdfs:label: refundStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a refund is.

@graph.rdfs:label: refundMethod
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where the money goes back.

@graph.rdfs:label: couponApplication
@graph.rdfs:comment: How a coupon reaches an order.

@graph.rdfs:label: discountLayer
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a discount applies: item price, order, or add-on.

@graph.rdfs:label: promotionStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a promotion is in its life.

@graph.rdfs:label: displayStatus
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a display booking is in its life.

@graph.rdfs:label: slotType
@graph.rdfs:comment: What a display slot holds.

@graph.rdfs:label: memberState
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether a member can use the store.

@graph.rdfs:label: preferenceKey
@graph.rdfs:comment: What a remembered preference is about.

@graph.rdfs:label: changeSetState
@graph.rdfs:comment: Where a change set is: drafting to live or undone.

@graph.rdfs:label: taskState
@graph.rdfs:comment: Whether a task needs a person, is being worked on, or is done.

@graph.rdfs:label: taskOrigin
@graph.rdfs:comment: How a task started.

@graph.rdfs:label: startedAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: When the step, turn, or job started.

@graph.rdfs:label: endedAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: When the step, turn, or job ended.

@graph.rdfs:label: expiresAt
@graph.rdfs:comment: When this stops being valid (a preview, a session, an idempotency record).

@graph.rdfs:label: title
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short name shown to people (a change set, a task).

@graph.rdfs:label: label
@graph.rdfs:comment: A short name the owner gave this (for example an address called Home).

@graph.rdfs:label: summary
@graph.rdfs:comment: One or two sentences that say what happened or what is needed.

@graph.rdfs:label: number
@graph.rdfs:comment: The number people see, such as change set 1042.
